All: Extreme macro detail on the outfits, the skin and the shadows. TWO completely different extreme physiques must CONTRAST and DOMINATE every inch of frame. Full-length wide shot from a medium distance with the camera at knee height, the famous landmark large in the foreground at the centre of the frame with one woman standing on each side of it slightly behind it, the whole figure of both women from their feet to the top of their heads completely visible, the towering heels clearly separating their shoes from the ground with the real buildings, cars and trees around their ankles shown at their true size so their colossal height and the extreme heel height read at a glance.
